title: HIV-Flow Assay
author: Marion Pardons
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w4efgte
materials: Count the cells with Trypan Blue.
Perform the extracellular staining (using your antibodies for cell-surface antigens of interest) in PBS/HS4% (final volume = 100µL/tube) (20-30min, 4°C)

steps.title: Thaw PBMCs and resuspend
steps.instruction: Thaw cryopreserved PBMCs (10‑50 ×10⁶ cells, HIV‑infected and equal number from uninfected control) and immediately resuspend each in 25 mL cRPMI.

steps.title: Set aside control PBMCs
steps.instruction: Keep the uninfected control PBMCs for FACS compensation (≈100 000 cells per antibody to be used).

steps.title: Centrifuge and break pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells 5 min at 1 500 rpm, discard supernatant and gently tap the tube to break the cell pellet.

steps.title: Negative selection of CD4 T cells
steps.instruction: Perform EasySep CD4⁺ T‑cell negative selection according to total cell count.

substeps.instruction: If >50 ×10⁶ cells: resuspend pellet in 800 µL EasySep Buffer and adjust to 50 ×10⁶ cells/mL.
If 10‑50 ×10⁶ cells: resuspend pellet in 800 µL EasySep Buffer.
Transfer the suspension to a 14 mL round‑bottom tube.
Add 25 µL Ab cocktail (catalog 19052) per mL of cells; incubate 10 min at room temperature (RT).
Vortex beads 30 s, add 50 µL EasySep beads per mL of cells; incubate 5 min at RT.
Add EasySep Buffer up to a total volume of 5 mL (if cell volume is 5 mL).
Place the tube (cap off) in the magnet for 5 min.
Carefully pipet the untouched cells into a 50 mL tube containing cRPMI up to 20 mL.
Centrifuge 5 min at 1 500 rpm and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend in ARV and count
steps.instruction: Resuspend the isolated CD4⁺ cells in 800 µL cRPMI containing antiretroviral (ARV) drug (stock 100×) and determine viability/count with Trypan Blue.

steps.title: Plate cells at 2×10⁶/mL
steps.instruction: Adjust cell concentration to 2 ×10⁶ cells/mL in cRPMI + ARV (stock 100×) and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in appropriate culture plates:

substeps.instruction: <200 µL → 96‑well plate
200‑500 µL → 48‑well plate
500 µL‑1.5 mL → 24‑well plate
1.5‑2.5 mL → 12‑well plate
2.5‑3.5 mL → 6‑well plate

steps.title: Optional BFA addition for phenotyping
steps.instruction: If immunophenotyping is required, add Brefeldin A (BFA) to the culture medium at a 2 000× dilution; omit this step when only measuring p24⁺ frequency.

steps.title: Rest cells before stimulation
steps.instruction: Rest the cultures for at least 1 hour before PMA/ionomycin stimulation.

steps.title: Add PMA/Ionomycin stimulus
steps.instruction: Stimulate according to donor treatment status:

substeps.instruction: ART‑treated: PMA 162 nM, Ionomycin 1 µg/mL, 24 h. Prepare 10× stock by mixing 10 µL PMA + 10 µL ionomycin + 80 µL medium; dilute 1:100 (10 µL diluted mix per mL of cells).
Untreated: PMA 25 nM, Ionomycin 1 µg/mL, 18 h. Prepare 64.8× stock by mixing 2.3 µL PMA + 15 µL ionomycin + 132.7 µL medium; dilute 1:100 (10 µL diluted mix per mL of cells).
Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for the indicated 18 h (untreated) or 24 h (treated).

steps.title: Collect cells and limit tube load
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to 5 mL tubes, wash each well with PBS, and ensure no more than 10 ×10⁶ cells are placed in any tube.

steps.title: Viability staining with Vivid
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1 800 rpm for 3 min, discard supernatant, then resuspend cells in 200 µL PBS containing Vivid dye (5 µL Vivid 1:10 + 195 µL PBS per condition; alternatively 2 µL Vivid + 18 µL PBS = 20 µL).

steps.title: Incubate viability dye
steps.instruction: Incubate the Vivid‑stained cells 20‑30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: First PBS/HS4% wash
steps.instruction: Wash cells once with 800 µL PBS containing 4 % HS, centrifuge 1 800 rpm for 3 min, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Second PBS/HS4% wash
steps.instruction: Wash cells with 1.8 mL PBS/HS4%, centrifuge 1 800 rpm for 3 min, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL FoxP3 Fix/Perm Buffer (1:4 dilution: 1 mL concentrate + 3 mL diluent) to each tube, incubate 45 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash after fixation
steps.instruction: Wash with 1.8 mL FoxP3 Perm Buffer (10× dilution: 1 mL Perm Buffer + 9 mL H₂O), centrifuge 3 min at 2 100 rpm, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Intracellular antibody staining
steps.instruction: Prepare a 100 µL staining mix per tube in FoxP3 Perm Buffer:

substeps.instruction: Dilution A (KC57): 1 µL antibody + 9 µL buffer (10‑fold).
Dilution B (p24 28B7): 1 µL antibody + 9 µL buffer (10‑fold).
Dilution C (combined): 1 µL Dil A + 1 µL Dil B + 98 µL FoxP3 Perm Buffer.
Add 100 µL of the combined mix to the cells, incubate 45 min at room temperature; do not vortex antibodies or mixes.
Note: p24 antibody batch must be titrated upon receipt.

steps.title: Wash after intracellular stain
steps.instruction: Wash cells with 1.8 mL FoxP3 Perm Buffer, centrifuge 3 min at 2 100 rpm, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Final resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the stained cells in 100‑200 µL PBS (no human serum).
